title: Pastor Godspower Celebrates His Birthday
summary: The TFCG family came together to celebrate Pastor Godspower Opara Martins' birthday with praise, prayer, and thanksgiving.
content: The Faith Centre Global family gathered in celebration of Pastor Godspower Opara Martins' birthday, honoring the grace of God upon his life and ministry. The congregation shared testimonies of how his teaching has shaped their walk with God, followed by a time of praise, prayer, and thanksgiving for many more fruitful years of kingdom impact. We give God thanks for our shepherd and covet your continued prayers over his life and family.

title: Annual Faith Conference — Save the Date
summary: Mark your calendars — the Annual Faith Conference returns this November with a fresh prophetic emphasis.
content: We are excited to announce that the Annual Faith Conference will hold this November, bringing together believers for a multi-day gathering focused on being equipped, imparted, and sent forth. Expect dynamic worship, deep teaching from the Word, and a mighty move of the Holy Spirit. Registration details and the full conference schedule will be shared soon — see the Events page for updates as they're published.

title: Community Prayer Walk
summary: TFCG members took to the streets of Okota in a community prayer walk, declaring peace and blessing over the neighborhood.
content: As part of our ongoing outreach mandate, members of The Faith Centre Global embarked on a prayer walk through the streets of Okota, interceding for peace, safety, and revival in our community. The walk was a powerful reminder that our mission extends beyond the four walls of the church — we are called to carry God's presence into every space we occupy.

title: New Book Release: Commanding the Supernatural
summary: Pastor Godspower's newest book is now available at the church bookstore.
content: We're thrilled to announce the release of "Commanding the Supernatural," the latest book from Pastor Godspower Opara Martins. This book explores walking in the authority believers have been given to see the miraculous manifest in everyday life. Copies are available now — visit the Books page to get yours.

title: Thanksgiving Service Recap
summary: A joyful Sunday of thanksgiving as the congregation celebrated God's faithfulness over the past season.
content: This past Sunday, The Faith Centre Global held a special Thanksgiving Service, giving God praise for His faithfulness over the past season — answered prayers, healings, and testimonies of breakthrough. The atmosphere was filled with jubilant worship and heartfelt gratitude as members shared what God had done in their lives.
